# agiter

A client-agnostic harness for spec-driven agentic development. The design is in
[docs/design-recap.md](docs/design-recap.md).

A run's pipeline is always given explicitly: a comma list of tokens, or a pipeline file
(`*.json`, `{ "steps": [...] }`). A token is `task` (one round, no review) or `task:N` (at most
N rounds; each round is a version and its review report).

Status: step 1 (inputs, artifacts, tasks, pipelines, the run engine, simulation) and a first
real executor: `agiter run` calls the agent CLI of each role's model profile
(`.agiter/config/.models.<role>.json`, `.agiter/config/.models.json`, copied from the package's defaults on the first run; agents in `defs/agents.json`). In a git repository
every run works on its own branch `agiter/<run>`, the harness commits every call, the scope
of a step is checked against what git sees, and `agiter finish [--merge]` ends the run.

## Layout

| Path | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `index.mjs` | the public API |
| `bin/agiter.mjs` | the CLI on commander (`agiter --help`, `agiter <command> --help`) |
| `sidecar.mjs` | JSON-RPC over stdio for long-lived clients (Far Manager) |
| `src/` | the modules: definitions, pipelines, artifacts, engine, tools, log |
| `defs/` | the package's artifact types and tasks |
| `test/` | `npm test` (node:test, no dependencies) |

A project keeps everything in `.agiter/`: `docs/<run>/` (the chain of each run), `runs/`,
`logs/`, its own definitions (`artifacts/`, `tasks/`, merged over the package's) and
`checks.json` (the required checks).

## A run's files

```text
.agiter/docs/<run>/<run>.md                    the input, copied as it is (never changed)
.agiter/docs/<run>/<run>.draft.1.md            round 1 of create-draft:3
.agiter/docs/<run>/<run>.draft.1.report.md     its review: Block or Done, cumulative
.agiter/docs/<run>/<run>.draft.2.md            round 2: input + draft.1 + its report
...
```

A version is Active when another step follows and it has no review or its report is Done;
otherwise Draft. A step takes only prose or an Active artifact whose latest report is not
Block. The state of a run is its files: `agiter continue` walks the steps again and repeats
nothing done.

## Try it

```text
agiter list tasks
agiter plan --pipeline "create-draft:3,create-spec:2,create-work,checks" --text "Add a login form"
agiter simulate --pipeline "create-draft:3,create-spec:2,create-work" --text "Add a login form" --script script.json
agiter continue --root <project printed by simulate>
```

A simulation script says what the fake model returns, per task, role and attempt:

```json
{
	"steps": {
		"create-draft#1/review": { "findings": [{ "text": "Problem unclear" }] },
		"create-draft#2": { "responses": { "F-1": "fixed: Problem rewritten" } },
		"create-work": { "changes": ["src/login.js"] }
	}
}
```
